description: US fashion and lifestyle brand famous for the Nap Dress, offering apparel, bedding, bath, baby and home products that bring beauty and joy to everyday rituals, per its official affiliate page and impact.com case study.

evidence.summary: Official affiliate page: join to earn commissions, 30-day cookie window, 'competitive commission rate' (no % stated), managed by El Toro Interactive, Join Now links to app.impact.com, plus a ShopMy programme. Contact: affiliate@eltorointeractive.com. No cap statement.
Later listing reports Hill House Home at up to 10.5% commission with a 30-day cookie duration.

impact.com case study: Hill House grew affiliate to a seven-figure channel in year one, onboarded 399 new affiliates across editorial, loyalty, influencer and tech, and added partners including Who What Wear, Rank & Style, Capital One and Rakuten — evidence of a large, saturated partner base.

name: Hill House Home

opportunity.title: Hill House Home Affiliate Program via Impact / ShopMy

reasons.compensation: A published up-to-10.5% rate exists via Later, but there is no explicit uncapped statement, so it cannot score high.
reasons.contact_access: A direct affiliate-team email, affiliate@eltorointeractive.com, is published on the official programme page.
reasons.credibility: Official programme page plus a detailed impact.com case study with dated results verify the brand and programme.
reasons.niche_fit: Excellent fashion/home/lifestyle crossover fit centred on the highly visual Nap Dress.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Programme is open via the official page's Impact Join Now link and via ShopMy.
reasons.ugc_evidence: impact.com documents content-first editorial and influencer partnerships at scale, plus ShopMy creator linking.

description: Los Angeles-based luggage and travel accessories brand selling suitcases, backpacks, duffels and packing accessories; runs an official affiliate program on Impact for travel and lifestyle creators/publishers with US audiences, also available via Skimlinks, LTK/RewardStyle and MagicLinks.

evidence.summary: Official affiliate page: free to join, 30-day cookie, commission on every referred order, apply via Impact signup link, US-audience partners only; CALPAK partners with Impact and is also available via Skimlinks, LTK/RewardStyle and MagicLinks. No commission % and no cap statement on the official page.
Lasso listing: CALPAK Travel affiliate program pays 8% per sale, 30-day cookie.

Beacons Universe: 536 creators have posted about CALPAK Travel all time, 31 in the last 30 days to 2026-11-20, 253 public posts in last 12 months, 24 sponsored posts in last 12 months — clearly saturated.

BravoDM (checked Oct 2026): affiliate program for travel/lifestyle creators with US audiences, no follower minimum stated, listed as calpaktravel.com/pages/affiliate-program on Impact; Instagram @calpak.

name: CALPAK

opportunity.title: CALPAK Affiliate Program on Impact — open application, US-audience creators/publishers

reasons.compensation: Published 8% per sale exists, but no explicit uncapped statement was found, so compensation cannot score high.
reasons.contact_access: Open affiliate application page plus general help@calpaks.com; press email only found in a third-party Beacons list, no direct partnerships inbox verified.
reasons.credibility: Program, network and cookie are confirmed on the brand's own official page.
reasons.niche_fit: Core luggage/travel brand, a direct fit for travel UGC.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Program is live and openly joinable via Impact, gated only by approval and US audience.
reasons.ugc_evidence: 536 Beacons creators and 24 sponsored posts in 12 months show heavy, ongoing creator activity.

description: New York-based premium luggage, bags and travel accessories brand founded in 2015, sold online and in retail stores; no affiliate/ambassador program is listed on its own site, but aggregator listings offer access, and it runs a separate capped Refer-a-Friend program ($40 x max 5 = $200, not an affiliate program).

evidence.summary: LinkApprove directory: Away affiliate program pays up to 7% per sale, 30-day cookie, avg. order $310, US/CA/UK/EU per its travel category page, commission validates on shipment. No cap statement.
Shopper.com listing conflicts on rate: Awaytravel affiliate program at 2.4% payout per sale with instant approval through Shopper.com — rate is therefore not settled across listings.

Snippet (checked 2026-11-14, sourced from awaytravel.com): Away lists influencer@awaytravel.com for influencer/social, press@awaytravel.com for press, partnerships@awaytravel.com for partnerships; Away does not list an influencer, ambassador or affiliate program on the pages checked.
Beacons Universe: 547 creators have posted about Away all time, 30 in the last 30 days to 2026-11-20, 193 public posts in last 12 months with sponsored posts in Nov/Oct/Sep 2026 — clearly saturated.
Official Refer-a-Friend terms (not affiliate): $40 reward per qualified referral, maximum 5 referrals / $200, and the program explicitly cannot be used for affiliate lead generation.

name: Away

opportunity.title: Away Affiliate Program via LinkApprove (up to 7% per sale, 30-day cookie)

reasons.compensation: Up to 7% is published by LinkApprove but a second listing says 2.4%, and no explicit uncapped statement exists.
reasons.contact_access: Dedicated influencer, partnerships and press inboxes are all published on the brand's own pages (via Snippet's dated check).
reasons.credibility: Contacts trace to awaytravel.com, but the affiliate program itself is listing-only and rates conflict between listings.
reasons.niche_fit: Core premium luggage/travel brand, a direct fit for travel UGC.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Access is only through aggregators (LinkApprove/Shopday/Shopper); there is no official joinable program page.
reasons.ugc_evidence: 547 Beacons creators, 30 active in the last 30 days, with recent sponsored posts.

description: US online retailer of men's apparel, outdoor gear and lifestyle products, curating independent labels plus house brands. Its official affiliates page recruits publishers to earn commission on referred sales via banner ads or text links.

evidence.summary: Official affiliates page, verified in full: 'Apply for the Huckberry Affiliate program via Partnerize'; Standard Program Fees list 'Partnerize - 8%'; 15-day commission eligibility; no cap / unlimited-earnings statement anywhere in the terms.
Backlinko lists Huckberry as 'Best for outdoor and lifestyle fashion' with a commission rate of 5% to 10%, consistent with the official 8% Partnerize base rate.
Lists Huckberry's Instagram as http://instagram.com/huckberry, verifying the @huckberry handle.

name: Huckberry

reasons.compensation: An official published 8% Partnerize rate exists, but with no explicit uncapped statement compensation cannot score high under the rubric.
reasons.contact_access: No partnerships email is published; access is only through the Partnerize application on the official page.
reasons.credibility: Rate, network and terms are all stated on huckberry.com itself.
reasons.niche_fit: Men's fashion plus outdoor/travel gear is a very strong fit for this group's fashion/fitness/travel focus.
reasons.opportunity_availability: The program is live, free to join, and application steps are published on the official page.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The official page calls the program 'ever-expanding' and offers collaborative opportunities, but no creator counts were found, so saturation stays unknown.

description: American premium performance apparel brand headquartered in San Diego County, California, founded by Joe Kudla in 2015 and inspired by an active coastal California lifestyle integrating fitness, yoga, surf and life.

evidence.summary: Official Awin merchant profile for Vuori Clothing (US & Canada): 8% default commission, opportunity to earn increased commission, 30-day attribution, seasonally refreshed creative, dedicated management team, and questions directed to the Vuori Media Team; no cap/uncapped statement.

Official V1 Community Program: 40% off online and in store for certified fitness instructors, trainers, athletes, coaches and studio owners in the US, UK, Canada (ex-Quebec) and Australia; discount is personal-use and capped at 2,000 local currency per year — that is a discount cap, not a commission cap.

Guide sourced from vuoriclothing.com and Awin (read Nov 5, 2026): Vuori has no open influencer ambassador application; any creator can apply to the Awin affiliate program, and V1 is a discount, not pay.
Checked Nov 13, 2026: Vuori lists press@vuoriclothing.com for press inquiries only, explicitly not a creator/gifting route, and lists no creator route on its own pages.

name: Vuori

reasons.compensation: Awin publishes a clear 8% default rate with opportunity to earn more, but no explicit uncapped statement, so it scores mid, not high.
reasons.contact_access: A published press email, a support email on the official privacy policy, and Awin/V1 application routes are all available, though press is not a creator route.
reasons.credibility: An established US brand founded in 2015 with its affiliate terms published directly on Awin and its community terms on its own site.
reasons.niche_fit: Performance apparel spanning fitness, yoga, surf and everyday life fits fitness and travel-lifestyle creators well.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Both the Awin affiliate program and the V1 Community application are open, with V1 restricted to certified fitness professionals and athletes.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The official V1 page names many V1 Leaders and the program requires #ad on posts, but no Beacons/CollabFeed creator count was found.

description: Premium women's fitness apparel brand founded in 2020 by fitness influencer Krissy Cela, built on empowering women to feel confident and strong, with a cult following for collections such as Mellow Soft.

evidence.summary: Move Ambassadors program receives about 30,000 applicants each time it opens, 100 are selected for a gifted set, best performer becomes affiliated and earns commission, then ambassador on salary plus commission; no published commission rate or uncapped statement.

Secondary directory claims 7%-10% per sale via Impact with a disclaimer that figures are general and may vary; this conflicts with a Nov 2026 check reporting Oner's published creator rate as 'Not published', so no official rate is credited.
Beacons Universe: 818 creators have posted about Oner Active all time, 183 in the last 30 days, and 144 sponsored posts in the last 12 months — clear saturation evidence.
Official US page identifies Oner Active UK Ltd and lists info@oneractive.com for exercising rights/contact, and links Oner's Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook and X accounts.

name: Oner Active

reasons.compensation: No official published rate and no explicit uncapped statement were found, only a disclaimed secondary 7%-10% claim.
reasons.contact_access: Only a general info@ email was verified on an official page, with no verified partnerships email.
reasons.credibility: The brand, founder, revenue and ambassador model are documented by Glossy and its own official site.
reasons.niche_fit: Women's strength-training activewear is a direct fit for fitness/fashion creator content.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Move Ambassadors opens periodically with about 30,000 applicants for 100 gifted places, so it is highly competitive and not continuously open.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Beacons shows 818 creators and 144 sponsored posts in 12 months plus a large documented Move Ambassadors UGC program.

description: Los Angeles-based premium active lifestyle and yoga brand founded in 2005 by Jodi Guber Brufsky and Michelle Wahler, known for ultra-soft, body-inclusive activewear and now owned by Levi Strauss & Co.

evidence.summary: Official affiliate page promises 'Competitive Commission Earnings on all sales driven', a 30-day cookie and exclusive newsletters in 3 steps (create account, apply/approval, share links); it does NOT publish a commission rate, follower minimum, or cap statement.

Guide sourced from beyondyoga.com (read Nov 5, 2026): affiliate program is applied to via Rakuten Advertising; Fitness Ambassador Program is a 30%-off instructor discount whose 2026 intake said 'coming soon', not pay for posts.

Checked Nov 15, 2026: Beyond Yoga publishes no PR email; its creator route is the Beyond Yoga Creator Network on CreatorIQ for health/wellness creators of all sizes, approval required, with personal discount codes and seeding eligibility.
Beacons Universe: 501 creators have posted about Beyond Yoga all time, 27 in the last 30 days, and 99 sponsored posts in the last 12 months — clear saturation evidence.

name: Beyond Yoga

reasons.compensation: The official affiliate page publishes no rate at all and no uncapped statement, so compensation scores low despite secondary 5%-10% aggregator claims not credited here.
reasons.contact_access: A CreatorIQ application route and an official affiliate page exist, but no PR or partnerships email is published.
reasons.credibility: An established 2005 Los Angeles brand owned by Levi Strauss & Co. with programs documented on its own site.
reasons.niche_fit: Yoga, wellness and soft activewear content is a strong fit for fitness and lifestyle creators.
reasons.opportunity_availability: The affiliate program is open to apply to now, while the instructor ambassador intake for 2026 had not yet opened.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Beacons shows 501 creators and 99 sponsored posts in 12 months, plus a documented Creator Network with seeding.

name: Faherty

reasons.compensation: A published 4-7% range exists via Lasso, which is low, and there is no explicit uncapped statement.
reasons.contact_access: Excellent access with published press@, influencers@ and hello@ emails on the official FAQ.
reasons.credibility: Established US brand founded in 2013 with official FAQ confirmation and a Rakuten Advertising case study.

reasons.opportunity_availability: Official FAQ confirms a currently offered affiliate programme with a dedicated programme page.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Official influencer inquiry channel and Rakuten/ShopMy case study show creator/publisher work, but no UGC programme terms were published.

evidence.summary: Official Active Elite Ambassador Program for community fitness leaders: exclusive member discounts, VIP events, features across the brand community and product feedback, with 'Apply below' on the page; handle @lornajaneactive shown; no commission rate stated.
Republished Webgains program description: 'Commission: earn 5 commission', 30-day cookie, manual affiliate approval, banners and daily datafeed; no cap/uncapped statement.

Official contact page offers distinct routes for 'Media & Press' enquiries and 'Partnership & Wholesale' enquiries; no email address is published on the fetched page.
